name: Creality Ender Fast PLA @BBL A1 0.2 nozzle
inherits: Generic PLA High Speed @BBL A1 0.2 nozzle
filament_notes:
Creality manufacturer data, generated by scripts/shop_profiles/gen_filaments.py.
Dry 55 C for 12 h.
Manufacturer max speed 300 mm/s.
Max volumetric speed 2 mm3/s matches the manufacturer's rating for this printer.
US sells it as a 2 kg pack (2 x 1 kg); 1 kg CA/UK listings out of stock. CA page: 190-230C, hot bed 45-60C, 300 mm/s, tensile 46.23 MPa, bending 115.6 MPa, high fluidity '30 mm3/s'. CONFLICT: spool label 190-230C, bed 25-60C, 40-300 mm/s, fan 50-100% (fan_pct = upper bound). K2 Plus profile 220C/50C, 23 mm3/s; K2 Plus wiki lists Ender Fast PLA among filaments that should be dried. Creality wiki drying guide (generic PLA/PLA-CF row): Creality dryer 55C 8-12h, blast dryer 50-60C 8h; 'suggest' drying, required above 50% RH.
Source: https://store.creality.com/ca/products/ender-fast-1-75mm-pla-3d-printing-filament
